name: Barbell Lying Behind-the-Head Triceps Extension
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted firmly and hold a barbell above your chest using a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Angle your upper arms slightly back toward your head so your triceps stay under constant tension.
Bend your elbows smoothly to lower the bar behind the crown of your head into a deep triceps stretch.
Extend your elbows forcefully to press the bar back along the same arc while keeping your upper arms fixed.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary and elbows pointed up rather than flaring wide.
Use a full thumb-around grip and control the descent cleanly behind your head.
